package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for strings_trimleft_space_trimspace: `strings.TrimLeft(..., whitespace)` instead of `strings.TrimSpace(...)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario673Positive(s string) string {
	return strings.TrimLeft(s, " \t\n")
}
